Based on our insights from the proof of single-channel SDP tightness in Theorem 6 and additional empirical evidence in Appendix E, we conjecture that SDP tightness holds when C ≥ R: Conjecture 13 For any W ∈ RD×R , and any C ≥ R, it holds that RK,C,R (W) = RSDP K,R (W). In the next subsection, we prove Conjecture 13 in the special cases of K = 1 and K = D. As a consequence, we show that once C is large enough to realize all linear maps, RK,C,R (W) can be expressed as interesting closed form norms independent of C in these special cases. 4.4.
